name: Marsh Watchman
brief: Hunched reed-coated marsh monster; open face void, two free arms and planted boots; one ochre eye.

name: Cinder Knave
brief: Lean ash-grey goblin monster with a wedge nose, split feet and one dim ochre ember eye.

name: Chain Flail
brief: Short iron handle, visibly articulated chain and offset spiked iron weight; small ochre grip wrap.

name: Hearth Greatsword
brief: Heavy grey greatsword with a pointed bevelled blade, broad crossguard and ochre pommel.

name: Ash Spear
brief: Leaf-headed iron spear with a continuous grey shaft and one ochre binding.

name: Rivet Cuirass
brief: Empty wide riveted steel breastplate and two pauldrons, short waist; no person or limbs.

name: Lamellar Vest
brief: Empty short wide lamellar torso vest, staggered plate seams and two ochre laces; no figure.

name: Iron Hit Sparks
brief: Asymmetric metal impact shards around a tiny warm hub; no glow or uniform pinwheel.

name: Tavern Cask
brief: Small iron-banded tavern cask with an ochre bung and side tap.
